title: ME60300: Introduction To Human Body Mechanics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to Human Body MechanicsPrerequisite ; Mechanics
(Fluid Mechanics
or Thermo-fluid Sc.)Basic terminology and concept of human musculoskeletal
system, anatomy and overall function. Biomechanics of Tissues and Structures â
composition, structure and biomechanical behaviour: Bone and Muscle.
Biomechanics of Joints â Hip, Knee, Shoulder. Fundamental aspects of Joint
Replacement; Bone Remodelling. Introduction to Bio-Thermal-Fluid Sciences,
Fundamental equations of conservation, Constitutive relationships,
Viscoelasticity, Blood rheology, Mechanics of blood cells, Blood flow analysis,
Bioviscoelastic fluids, Fluid mechanics of circulatory systems.Books:(1)Basic
Biomechanics of the Musculoskeletal System (3rd edition), by M. Nordin and
V.H. Frankel, Publisher: LWW, ISBN: 0-683-30247-7.(2)Biomechanics by Y. C.
Fung, Springer (2nd Edition), ISBN 978-81-8128-811-0.(3)An Introduction to
Biomechanics, by J.D. Humphery and S.L. Delange, Publisher: Springer, ISBN 97881-8128-719-9.
